1. Setting up the script
#######################################

Set up filepath, notation and packages
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(scipen = 100, digits = 4)

#Set filepath
setwd("/Users/langgao/Downloads/Freelancer projects/Sonder/Indonesia/Segmentation")
```

Load packages
```{r,echo=TRUE}
rm(list=ls())
pacman::p_load("ggplots","tidyverse","survey","dplyr","forcats","haven")
```

Load dataset
```{r}
dhs.seg <- readRDS("5_Indonesia_DHS_exploratory.rds")
dhs.seg.des <- readRDS("5_Indonesia_DHS_exploratory.des.rds")
#dim(dhs.seg) #49627   311
p_list <- list()
```

Function setup
```{r}
f_ageExplore <- function(measure,var.class,data=dhs.seg,survey.des=dhs.seg.des){
  if(is.null(var.class)){
    print('Variable type/class not provided so using default class coding, check if this is appropriate!')
    v.class <- class(dhs.seg.des$variables[,measure])
    
    #recoding integers that are not 0/1 to numeric
    v.class <- ifelse(v.class!='numeric' & v.class!='factor' & !all(na.omit(dhs.seg %>% pull(eval(parse(text=measure)))) %in% 0:1),'numeric',v.class)
  }
  else{v.class <- var.class}
  
  
  ## 1: Descriptive tables: Contigency table for categorical/binary data, means and CIs for continuous by age group
  if(v.class %in% c('binary','categorical','factor','character')){
    des.res.count <- round(svytable(as.formula(paste0("~age.adj +",measure)), dhs.seg.des),digits=2)
    ## proportion of education level within each age group (same as plot below)
    des.res.prop <- round(prop.table(svytable(as.formula(paste0("~age.adj +",measure)), dhs.seg.des),margin=1)*100,2)  
    
    des.res <- list('tab.count'=des.res.count,'tab.prop'=des.res.prop)
  }
  else if(v.class %in% c('numeric')){
    des.res <- svyby(as.formula(paste0("~",measure)), ~age.adj, dhs.seg.des, svymean,ci=TRUE,vartype="ci", na.rm=T)
  }

  
  ### 2: Descriptive charts of distribution of vulnerability by age group ###
  if(v.class %in% c('binary','categorical','factor','character')){
    pdat <- data.frame(round(prop.table(svytable(as.formula(paste0("~age.adj +",measure)), dhs.seg.des),margin=1)*100,2))
    names(pdat)[names(pdat)==measure] <- 'measure'
    p <- ggplot(data=pdat,aes(fill=measure, y=Freq, x=age.adj)) + geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity") +
          xlab('Age group') + ylab(measure) + theme(legend.title = element_blank()) + ggtitle('Proportion of vulnerability by age group')
  }
  else if(v.class %in% c('numeric')){
    pdat <- svyby(as.formula(paste0("~",measure)), ~age.adj, dhs.seg.des, svyquantile,       
                  quantiles = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), na.rm = TRUE, ci=TRUE, 
                  keep.var = TRUE, 
                  vartype = "ci")
    boxstats <- pdat[,1:6]
    names(boxstats) <- c('age.adj','q0','q25','q50','q75','q100')
    p <- ggplot(boxstats,
                aes(x=age.adj, ymin=q0, lower=q25,middle=q50,
                    upper=q75,ymax=q100)) + geom_boxplot(stat='identity') + 
      coord_cartesian(ylim= c(min(boxstats[,2:6]),1.05*max(boxstats$q75))) + ylab(measure)
    
  }
  
  ### 3: Tests of association between age and vulnerability
  if(v.class %in% c('binary','categorical','factor','character')){
    svy.chi <- svychisq(as.formula(paste0('~',measure, "+ age.adj")), dhs.seg.des, statistic="Chisq")
    mod.res <- svy.chi
  }
  else if(v.class %in% c('numeric')){
    svy.glm <- svyglm(as.formula(paste0(measure, "~ age.adj")),family=gaussian(link ="identity"),design=dhs.seg.des, data=dhs.seg)
    LRT.pval.measure <- regTermTest(svy.glm, 'age.adj', method = "LRT")$p
    mod.res <- list('model'=summary(svy.glm),'global.p'=LRT.pval.measure)
  }
  
  all_res <- list('stats'=des.res, 'plot'=p, 'model'=mod.res)
  return(all_res)
}
```

```{r}
for (col_name in names(dhs.seg)) 
  { if ("haven_labelled" %in% class(dhs.seg[[col_name]])) dhs.seg[[col_name]] <- as.character(dhs.seg[[col_name]])  }
```


## 1. Woman and her past experience
Ensure the path
```{r}
plots_dir <- "Plots"
if (!dir.exists(plots_dir)) {
  dir.create(plots_dir)
}
```

### 1.1. Women's education
#### 1.1.1. ed.lev.ord
```{r}
vul.measure <- 'ed.lev.ord'
dhs.seg$ed.lev.ord <- as.factor(dhs.seg$ed.lev.ord)
#class(dhs.seg$ed.lev.ord)
out <- f_ageExplore(measure = vul.measure,var.class = 'factor',data = dhs.seg,survey.des = dhs.seg.des)

#table
out$stats
#plot
plot(out$plot)

#plots single plot per pdf 
pdf(file = file.path(plots_dir, paste0("age_expl_", vul.measure, '.pdf')), height = 8, width = 12)
plot(out$plot)
dev.off() #to close the PDF device when done

#model
out$model
```
